snippet.title: SCALE: Rise of Dragons
snippet.description:
SCALE is a competitive card game featuring a 52-card deck of unique and powerful dragon cards. Players share the same deck, ensuring a level playing field where strategy and skill are paramount.

Play for FREE at: www.scale.cards/play
Learn to play: https://upscale.games/how-to-play
Join our discord: https://discord.gg/uC6Pqj99

#scale #cards #dragons #infinitus
